normalization: strict UTF-8; NFC; CRLF/CR to LF; exactly one terminal LF
offset_unit: Python Unicode code-point index into normalized source
chunking: each H2 or H3 begins a semantic section; sections over 512 tokens split at blank-line paragraph boundaries into consecutive reconstructive parts; deeper headings remain in their parent
section_key: source_key plus unique ASCII heading slug, with part-N suffix only for split sections
token_count: FastEmbed tokenizer count; each chunk is at most 512 tokens
